items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I recorded with all the bands—Count Basie—all of the bands and everything

ctx.x: See, well then you answering exactly what I‘m talking about. If they did, you see, there was a lot of good bands on the road back in them days. Cab Calloway, Jimmie Lunceford, Count Basie…what‘s that? Name some of them bands.
